# Rust standard-library notices

The isolated Rust probe links the Rust standard library. These unmodified notices and license texts come from the installed Rust1.91.1 toolchain distribution. SOURCES.json records their exact hashes and compiler revision. COPYRIGHT-library.html covers the standard library and its build dependencies, including conditional code for other platforms; it is retained in full, rather than treating every listed dependency as linked into this WASM.

This folder contains notices only. It adds no player, GPL SID reference engine, firmware or music to the candidate build.
